authority.human: selects account, contract, operating mode, and may submit manual intent
authority.hermes: owns probabilistic market judgment and trade intent
authority.glitch: owns truthful ProjectX evidence, identity, execution, protection, reconciliation, and receipts
authority.deterministic_rejection: limited to factual execution invalidity, authoritative venue/account boundaries, unprovable ownership or protection, duplicate or ambiguous mutation, and explicit operator disablement
authority.forbidden: hidden strategy gates, arbitrary risk preferences, trade creation without human or Hermes intent, and intent mutation outside the requested range

history.note: The detailed historical rail remains immutable in Git history. This ledger is the smaller active release authority. Roadmap ideas are not active tickets until promoted here with evidence and acceptance.

items.title: Keep quiet-tape evidence in Hermes cognition, not the execution gate
acceptance: Configured armed mode remains armed when reconciled venue state is current and the 60-second tape contains zero prints.
Decision packets retain the full rolling order-flow observation and trade count.
No tape, spread, depth, volatility, session, or confidence observation independently authorizes or forbids entry.
Quote freshness, reconciliation, capacity, recovery, ownership, protection, and explicit operator mode remain factual gates.
EXIT remains available under entry-only degraded state.
evidence: src/execution/gateway-mode.ts removes order_flow_trades_60s and order_flow_no_trades_60s from execution admission.
tests/gateway-mode.test.ts proves quiet tape is preserved as evidence and cannot select an action.
tests/position-management.test.ts proves EXIT under a factual stale-quote degraded state.
docs/AUTHORITY.md records the four-question doctrine decision.
GitHub Actions ci run 30773272688: build green; 179/179 tests pass.

items.title: Zero duplicate entries in a real ProjectX kill and reconnect acceptance session
acceptance: An explicitly approved disposable ProjectX acceptance session exercises kill, reconnect, and same-intent retry without duplicate exposure.
Durable intent id, canonical body hash, custom tag, provider order identity, and final account state agree.
items.blocked_reason: Requires an operator-approved real ProjectX mutation and credentials on the target Windows machine; source and fake-provider kill matrices are already green.
items.stop_line: Do not characterize fake-provider or read-only evidence as a real order-mutation acceptance.

items.title: Real ProjectX historical order and trade identity retention
acceptance: Historical order search retains custom tags and full order identity.
Historical trade search retains trade.orderId linkage to submitted entries.
items.blocked_reason: Requires account history and an authenticated target-machine capture.

items.title: Sustained stream-rate and evidence-disk-growth measurement
acceptance: Quote, print, and depth event rates are measured over a named market interval.
Evidence retention and actual disk growth are recorded with start/end timestamps and bytes per event.
items.existing_evidence: Windows reboot evidence preserved 112853 events and a 126013440-byte ProjectX evidence database without corruption.
items.blocked_reason: The existing sample proves persistence but does not yet provide a bounded start/end rate calculation.

items.title: One-account beta promotion
acceptance: Installed gateway and Hermes profile pass shadow and approved Sim/PRAC acceptance on the target machine.
No duplicate entries, unexplained exposure, or unprotected attributable position occurs.
Restart, reconnect, pause, flatten, and receipt paths are evidenced.
The operator explicitly promotes the named immutable artifact to beta.
items.stop_line: No claim of beta readiness before the cross-repository profile acceptance and operator-approved real mutation evidence are attached.
